rules.rule: Text contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for normal text (WCAG AA), 3:1 for large text (18sp+ or 14sp bold). Never use light gray on white or dark gray on black.
Minimum touch target 44x44dp for all interactive elements. If icon is smaller, add invisible padding to reach 44dp. Distance between touch targets minimum 8dp.
All icons must have content descriptions. Form fields must have visible labels (not just placeholder text). Error messages must describe the problem and how to fix it.
Keyboard/screen reader focus must follow logical visual order (top-left to bottom-right). Focus indicator must be visible (2dp ring in primary color).
All animations must respect system reduced-motion setting. Animations used for meaning (loading, progress) must have a non-animated fallback state.
